observed_behavior: A preliminary report with missing Ready commands and source obligations has zero generic schema or semantic errors and is still accepted by persistence although Ready validation reports errors.
expected_behavior: Persistence, Outcome derivation and Delivery consumption load the same run-bound Ready handoff and require the owner Ready-review validator to return zero errors.
impact: Incomplete command and requirement coverage can be persisted and bound into an Outcome, weakening specification-to-review traceability.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: Any Ready validation error causes all three preliminary-review consumer boundaries to fail closed.
steps: Start from a schema-valid preliminary report.
Remove Ready command outcomes and one source obligation while retaining generic validity.
Compare Ready validator diagnostics with isolated persistence acceptance.
reproduction.sample: Generic schema and semantics returned zero errors, Ready validation returned two errors, and persistence accepted the report.

root_cause.summary: The persistence, Outcome and Delivery preliminary-review consumers invoke generic validation but omit the bound Ready handoff and validate_review_against_ready.

next_action: Implementation executor adds persistence, Outcome and Delivery Ready-validation reds, implements stable run-bound Ready loading, and reruns integration, full verification and fresh review.
